title: Scaffold Vite project with dependencies
description: Initialize Vite project with React + TypeScript template. Install: tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, zustand, @dnd-kit/core, @dnd-kit/sortable, lucide-react, date-fns, nanoid. Configure Tailwind with design tokens from architecture spec.

criteria.text: Vite dev server runs without errors
Tailwind configured with all color tokens from architecture-spec.md (bg-primary, accent-primary, category colors, etc.)
TypeScript compiles with no errors
All listed dependencies installed

title: Create TypeScript type definitions
description: Create src/types/index.ts with all types from architecture-spec.md: Task, Category, Tag, Settings, Attachment, Subtask, IterationState, Priority, CategoryType. Include default category and tag data.

criteria.text: All types match architecture-spec.md data model exactly
Default categories (Research, Design, Testing, Review, Discovery, Handoff, Admin) with correct colors
Default tags list matches spec
TypeScript strict mode passes

title: Set up Zustand stores with localStorage persistence
description: Create three Zustand stores: taskStore (tasks with CRUD, move, reorder), uiStore (view, filters, panels, search — NOT persisted), settingsStore (theme, columns, categories, tags — persisted). Wire up localStorage sync for taskStore and settingsStore.

criteria.text: taskStore has: tasks array, addTask, updateTask, deleteTask, moveTask, reorderTasks actions
uiStore has: view, activeFilters, selectedTaskId, detailPanelOpen, settingsOpen, searchQuery
settingsStore has: theme, columnOrder, customCategories, customTags with update actions
Data persists across page reloads
Auto-save with 300ms debounce

title: Implement global styles and CSS variables
description: Set up src/index.css with Tailwind directives, CSS custom properties for the full color palette (light + dark), typography scale, and spacing tokens. Configure Tailwind dark mode with 'class' strategy. Add custom font imports (Cabinet Grotesk, Inter, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts.

criteria.text: All color tokens from architecture-spec.md accessible as CSS variables
Dark mode toggles by adding 'dark' class to html element
Font stack: Cabinet Grotesk headings, Inter body, JetBrains Mono for estimates
Global reset and base styles applied
Custom scrollbar styling matching design language

title: Build AppShell and Header components
description: Create layout/AppShell.tsx as the main container. Create layout/Header.tsx with: logo + 'DesignFlow' text, view toggle (Board/List/Focus), search icon button, settings icon button, theme toggle (sun/moon icon button). Header is fixed, 56px height with bottom border.

criteria.text: Header matches architecture-spec layout exactly
View toggle shows active state correctly
Theme toggle switches between light/dark and updates CSS variables
AppShell provides correct page layout structure
Responsive: collapses gracefully on tablet

title: Implement dark/light theme toggle system
description: Wire up settingsStore theme to document.documentElement.classList. Support 'light', 'dark', and 'system' modes. When system is selected, use media query match. Apply Tailwind dark: variants globally. Theme state persists to localStorage.

criteria.text: Theme toggle cycles through light → dark → system → light
System mode respects OS preference
All colors switch correctly between light and dark modes
Theme preference persists across page reloads
No flash of wrong theme on page load (inline script or CSS)

title: Build StatusBar component
description: Create layout/StatusBar.tsx: fixed bottom 32px bar showing task count summary ('25 tasks · 3 in progress') and 'Last saved just now' indicator. Auto-updates with task counts from taskStore. Shows save status: idle / saving / saved.

criteria.text: Shows accurate total task count and in-progress count
Save indicator shows correct state
Matches design spec (32px, bottom-fixed)
Does not interfere with content scroll

title: Build KanbanBoard and KanbanColumn components
description: Create board/KanbanBoard.tsx and board/KanbanColumn.tsx. KanbanBoard wraps DndContext. KanbanColumn renders a vertical list of TaskCards within a SortableContext. Column header shows name + task count badge. Each column is droppable zone with visual highlight on drag-over. Scrollable task list within column.

criteria.text: 4 columns render: Backlog, In Progress, In Review, Approved
Tasks render in correct columns from store
Drop zones highlight on drag-over (2px indigo border + light indigo bg)
Column header shows task count
Empty columns show dot-grid placeholder
Horizontal scroll on overflow

title: Build TaskCard component with all states
description: Create board/TaskCard.tsx. Render: category chip, task title (truncated 3 lines), priority dots (1-5), time estimate (from timeEstimate field), due date, attachment icon (if attachments exist), subtask progress bar. Support all card states: default, hover (lift -2px), dragging (elevated + 3deg rotation + 50% origin opacity), selected (indigo border).

criteria.text: Card renders all metadata fields correctly
Category chip shows correct color from category definition
Hover state: translateY -2px + stronger shadow
Dragging state: elevated shadow + rotation + origin opacity
Selected state: 2px indigo border
Priority dots: filled dots for active priority, empty for rest
Subtask progress bar: thin colored bar showing X/Y completed
Attachments icon shown only when attachments exist

title: Implement drag-and-drop with @dnd-kit
description: Implement full drag-and-drop using @dnd-kit/core and @dnd-kit/sortable. Cards are useSortable items. Columns are droppable zones with custom collision detection. Cross-column drag moves task between iteration states. Within-column drag reorders by position. Keyboard alternative: Space to pick up selected, arrows to move, Space to drop, Esc to cancel.

criteria.text: Drag card from one column to another — task iterationState updates
Reorder within column — position updates correctly
Visual feedback during drag matches spec (shadow, rotation, opacity)
Drop zone highlights correctly
Touch: long-press activates drag mode
Keyboard: full alternative to mouse drag works
State persists after drag-drop (localStorage)

title: Build QuickAddBar with natural language parsing
description: Create shared/QuickAddBar.tsx: sticky input bar with placeholder 'Add a task... (Cmd+K)'. Implement natural language parser in utils/naturalLanguage.ts that extracts #category, @dueDate, Xh/Xm time estimate. On submit: create task with parsed fields, assign to Backlog (or current column context), clear input. Cmd+K shortcut focuses the bar from anywhere.

criteria.text: QuickAddBar is sticky below header
Cmd+K focuses the input from anywhere in the app
Parses #research → category=Research (and all other categories)
Parses tomorrow, next monday, mar 25, +3d → dueDate
Parses 2h, 30m, 2.5h → timeEstimate (in minutes)
Creates task in taskStore on Enter
Empty submit is silently ignored
Esc clears input and blurs

title: Build inline Add Task in columns
description: Add '+ Add task' button at bottom of each KanbanColumn. Clicking opens an inline input within the column (not the global QuickAddBar). Enter submits (creates task in that column), Esc cancels. Uses same natural language parser as QuickAddBar.

criteria.text: + Add task button visible at bottom of each column
Click opens inline input within the column
Enter creates task in that specific column
Esc cancels and hides the input
Created task immediately appears in column

title: Build TaskDetailPanel shell
description: Create task/TaskDetailPanel.tsx: slide-in panel from right (250ms ease-out). 400px wide on desktop, full-width bottom sheet on mobile. Semi-transparent backdrop overlay (click to close). X button top-right. Focus trap. Closes on Esc. No save button — auto-save on every change.

criteria.text: Panel slides in from right with 250ms ease-out animation
Backdrop overlay closes panel on click
Esc closes panel
Focus is trapped within panel when open
Panel width: 400px desktop, full-width mobile
X button closes panel

title: Implement all task detail fields
description: Add all editable fields to TaskDetailPanel: title (large inline-editable), category dropdown (colored chips), iteration state dropdown, priority (1-5 stars), due date (date picker + natural language input), time estimate (hours input), tags (multi-select with create custom). Each field auto-saves on change via updateTask in taskStore.

criteria.text: Title: click to edit, blur saves, large text
Category: dropdown with colored chip options
Iteration state: dropdown matching column names
Priority: 1-5 star selector with visual feedback
Due date: date picker input, accepts ISO dates
Time estimate: hours input (accepts decimal)
Tags: multi-select dropdown from default tags list + create new
All changes auto-save to taskStore

title: Implement attachments and subtasks
description: Add attachment and subtask sections to TaskDetailPanel. Attachments: URL input field, add button, each shows as clickable chip with label. URL auto-prepends https:// if missing. Subtasks: list of checklist items with checkbox, add subtask input at bottom. Each subtask has delete button. Completed subtasks get strikethrough.

criteria.text: Attachments: can add URL, displays as clickable chip
URLs without protocol auto-prepend https://
Subtasks: can add new subtask items
Subtasks: can toggle complete (checkbox)
Subtasks: can delete individual items
Subtask completion triggers progress bar update on TaskCard
All changes persist to taskStore

title: Implement task card click to open panel
description: Wire up TaskCard click → uiStore.selectedTaskId + detailPanelOpen. Clicking a card in the board opens the TaskDetailPanel populated with that task's data. Clicking outside the panel or pressing Esc closes it and clears selectedTaskId.

criteria.text: Clicking any TaskCard opens the detail panel
Panel populates with correct task data
Editing any field updates the card in the board view (reactive)
Closing panel clears selectedTaskId
Can open a different task's panel by clicking another card

title: Build FilterBar component
description: Create layout/FilterBar.tsx: horizontal row of category toggle chips below QuickAddBar. Each chip shows category name + count of tasks in that category. Click toggles filter. Active filter: filled background + checkmark. 'All' button clears filters. Multiple categories use OR logic. Active filter chips are removable (X button).

criteria.text: Category chips for all 7 default categories render
Each chip shows task count for that category
Click toggles filter active/inactive
Active filters have filled bg + checkmark
Multiple filters combine with OR logic
X button on active chips removes filter
'All' button resets all filters
Filter state updates board display reactively

title: Implement search functionality
description: Implement Cmd+F search: focuses search input in header. Search queries taskStore.tasks by title (substring match, case-insensitive). Results highlight matching text. Clear button resets search. Esc clears and closes.

criteria.text: Cmd+F focuses search input
Search filters visible tasks in real-time
Matching text highlighted in task cards
Clear (X) button resets search
Esc closes search and clears query
Empty search shows all tasks

title: Build EmptyState components
description: Create shared/EmptyState.tsx component with line-art SVG illustration, heading, subtext, and CTA button. Show in: empty column (contextual: 'Nothing in Backlog yet'), empty board (full-page: 'Your design workflow starts here'), empty search results. Context-aware copy for each scenario.

criteria.text: Empty column: subtle dot-grid placeholder + inline + Add button
Empty board: centered empty state with friendly copy + prominent Add button
Empty search: 'No tasks match "query"' with clear search button
All empty states use warm, encouraging copy (not generic)

title: Implement task completion flow
description: Implement task completion: checkbox on TaskCard click → mark task as completed (completedAt timestamp). Card animates to completed state (strikethrough + muted colors). After 2 seconds, card moves to Completed section (collapsible at bottom of Approved column). Completed section can be collapsed/expanded.

criteria.text: Checkbox click marks task complete with animation
Completed card shows strikethrough + muted colors
Card moves to Completed section after 2 seconds
Completed section is collapsible
Completed section shows within Approved column

title: Implement JSON export
description: Add data export to JSON. Button in settings panel (or status bar). Exports taskStore.tasks as formatted JSON file: designflow-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.json. Includes version field for future migration support.

criteria.text: Export downloads valid JSON file
Filename includes current date
JSON includes all tasks with all fields
JSON is valid and can be re-imported

title: Polish, animations, and accessibility pass
description: Final polish: verify all hover states, focus indicators, transitions, and micro-animations match architecture-spec.md. Verify dark mode on all components. Test keyboard navigation. Check accessibility: ARIA labels, focus management, color contrast. Test at 200% browser zoom.

criteria.text: All hover states match spec (lifts, shadows, color shifts)
All animations respect prefers-reduced-motion
Dark mode complete — every component styled for both themes
Full keyboard navigation works (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Esc)
ARIA labels on all interactive elements
Focus indicators styled (not browser default)
No layout breaks at 200% zoom
All touch targets minimum 44x44px
